public.title: Snowed In
public.blurb: Eight guests, one blizzard and a weekend that nobody will ever forget.
public.goal: Place everyone, then name the person who was alone with Vaughn Vane.
rules: One person per row and column, including the victim.
Crossed squares are blocked. All other squares may be occupied, including furniture without a cross.
Beside means one square up, down, left or right, within the same area.
A corner touches two adjacent area boundaries. Doors do not merge areas.
Alone means no other person in the area. With means in the same area; alone with means exactly two people.
Outer border means the first or last row or column of the whole grid.
In front of a door/window means either of its two joined squares.
Offsets compare only the named coordinate. Area numbers start at 1; zero people is an even count.
Terrain is the ground layer, separate from named props that may share its label.
The murderer was alone with the victim: exactly two people in that area.

clues.text: Esme Elwood was alone with Dorian Dale — only those two were in that area.
Vaughn Vane's row was 3 rows below Dorian Dale's row.
Basil Blackwood was the only person on a feather bed.
Ada Ashworth was beside a toboggan.
Dorian Dale was in a corner of their area.
Cleo Carrow was the only person beside a snowman.

clues.text: Dorian Dale was the only person on a sheepskin rug.
Esme Elwood was beside a feather bed.
Ada Ashworth was in the Ski Room.
Basil Blackwood's row was 3 rows below Cleo Carrow's row. Basil Blackwood was in the same area as Esme Elwood.
Vaughn Vane was in a corner of their area.
Felix Fairweather was not beside a ski rack.

public.title: The Last Lift Down
public.blurb: The pass is closed, the phone line is down, and someone at the lodge has very cold blood.
public.goal: Place everyone, then name the person who was alone with Vaughn Vane.
rules: One person per row and column, including the victim.
Crossed squares are blocked. All other squares may be occupied, including furniture without a cross.
Beside means one square up, down, left or right, within the same area.
A corner touches two adjacent area boundaries. Doors do not merge areas.
Alone means no other person in the area. With means in the same area; alone with means exactly two people.
Outer border means the first or last row or column of the whole grid.
In front of a door/window means either of its two joined squares.
Offsets compare only the named coordinate. Area numbers start at 1; zero people is an even count.
Terrain is the ground layer, separate from named props that may share its label.
The murderer was alone with the victim: exactly two people in that area.

clues.text: Esme Elwood's column was 2 columns to the right of Greta Gale's column. Esme Elwood was in the Boot Room.
Basil Blackwood was beside a rocking chair. Basil Blackwood was the only person in their area.
Ada Ashworth was alone with Dorian Dale — only those two were in that area.
Felix Fairweather was beside a ski rack.
Someone else in Dorian Dale's area was beside a fir tree.
Dorian Dale was the only person on a feather bed.
Cleo Carrow was in the Library.

public.title: Deadly Nightshade
public.blurb: Tea on the lawn, prizes for the best marrow and a guest who never came back from the greenhouses.
public.goal: Place everyone, then name the person who was alone with Violet Vane.
rules: One person per row and column, including the victim.
Crossed squares are blocked. All other squares may be occupied, including furniture without a cross.
Beside means one square up, down, left or right, within the same area.
A corner touches two adjacent area boundaries. Doors do not merge areas.
Alone means no other person in the area. With means in the same area; alone with means exactly two people.
Outer border means the first or last row or column of the whole grid.
In front of a door/window means either of its two joined squares.
Offsets compare only the named coordinate. Area numbers start at 1; zero people is an even count.
Terrain is the ground layer, separate from named props that may share its label.
The murderer was alone with the victim: exactly two people in that area.

public.goal: Place everyone, then name the person who was alone with Vincent Vane.
rules: One person per row and column, including the victim.
Crossed squares are blocked. All other squares may be occupied, including furniture without a cross.
Beside means one square up, down, left or right, within the same area.
A corner touches two adjacent area boundaries. Doors do not merge areas.
Alone means no other person in the area. With means in the same area; alone with means exactly two people.
Outer border means the first or last row or column of the whole grid.
In front of a door/window means either of its two joined squares.
Offsets compare only the named coordinate. Area numbers start at 1; zero people is an even count.
Terrain is the ground layer, separate from named props that may share its label.
The murderer was alone with the victim: exactly two people in that area.

rules: One person per row and column, including the victim.
Crossed squares are blocked. All other squares may be occupied, including furniture without a cross.
Beside means one square up, down, left or right, within the same area.
A corner touches two adjacent area boundaries. Doors do not merge areas.
Alone means no other person in the area. With means in the same area; alone with means exactly two people.
Outer border means the first or last row or column of the whole grid.
In front of a door/window means either of its two joined squares.
Offsets compare only the named coordinate. Area numbers start at 1; zero people is an even count.
Terrain is the ground layer, separate from named props that may share its label.
The murderer was alone with the victim: exactly two people in that area.

Dorian Dale was in the Reading Room.

Ada Ashworth was beside a circulation desk.

Outer border means the first or last row or column of the whole grid.
In front of a door/window means either of its two joined squares.
Offsets compare only the named coordinate. Area numbers start at 1; zero people is an even count.
Terrain is the ground layer, separate from named props that may share its label.
The murderer was alone with the victim: exactly two people in that area.

public.goal: Place everyone, then name the person who was alone with Valentina Vane.
rules: One person per row and column, including the victim.
Crossed squares are blocked. All other squares may be occupied, including furniture without a cross.
Beside means one square up, down, left or right, within the same area.
A corner touches two adjacent area boundaries. Doors do not merge areas.
Alone means no other person in the area. With means in the same area; alone with means exactly two people.
Outer border means the first or last row or column of the whole grid.
In front of a door/window means either of its two joined squares.
Offsets compare only the named coordinate. Area numbers start at 1; zero people is an even count.
Terrain is the ground layer, separate from named props that may share its label.
The murderer was alone with the victim: exactly two people in that area.

clues.text: Cleo Carrow's column was 1 column to the right of Greta Gale's column. Cleo Carrow was in a corner of their area.
Ada Ashworth was the only person beside a leather armchair.
Greta Gale was beside a faded rug. Greta Gale was alone with Dorian Dale — only those two were in that area.
Esme Elwood was the only person on a chesterfield sofa. Esme Elwood was in the same area as Felix Fairweather.
Valentina Vane was in the Porter's Lodge. Valentina Vane was not in a corner of their area.
Felix Fairweather was not in a corner of their area. Felix Fairweather was the only person beside a card catalogue.
Basil Blackwood was in a corner of their area.

public.title: The Purser's Ledger
public.blurb: A maiden voyage, a fortune in the purser's safe and a guest list that did not add up.
public.goal: Place everyone, then name the person who was alone with Violet Vane.
rules: One person per row and column, including the victim.
Crossed squares are blocked. All other squares may be occupied, including furniture without a cross.
Beside means one square up, down, left or right, within the same area.
A corner touches two adjacent area boundaries. Doors do not merge areas.
Alone means no other person in the area. With means in the same area; alone with means exactly two people.
Outer border means the first or last row or column of the whole grid.
In front of a door/window means either of its two joined squares.
Offsets compare only the named coordinate. Area numbers start at 1; zero people is an even count.
Terrain is the ground layer, separate from named props that may share its label.
The murderer was alone with the victim: exactly two people in that area.

public.title: Calm Seas, Cold Hearts
public.blurb: Champagne on the upper deck, fog on the water, and a scream that nobody admits to hearing.
public.goal: Place everyone, then name the person who was alone with Victor Vane.
rules: One person per row and column, including the victim.
Crossed squares are blocked. All other squares may be occupied, including furniture without a cross.
Beside means one square up, down, left or right, within the same area.
A corner touches two adjacent area boundaries. Doors do not merge areas.
Alone means no other person in the area. With means in the same area; alone with means exactly two people.
Outer border means the first or last row or column of the whole grid.
In front of a door/window means either of its two joined squares.
Offsets compare only the named coordinate. Area numbers start at 1; zero people is an even count.
Terrain is the ground layer, separate from named props that may share its label.
The murderer was alone with the victim: exactly two people in that area.

Beside means one square up, down, left or right, within the same area.
A corner touches two adjacent area boundaries. Doors do not merge areas.
Alone means no other person in the area. With means in the same area; alone with means exactly two people.
Outer border means the first or last row or column of the whole grid.
In front of a door/window means either of its two joined squares.
Offsets compare only the named coordinate. Area numbers start at 1; zero people is an even count.
Terrain is the ground layer, separate from named props that may share its label.
The murderer was alone with the victim: exactly two people in that area.

Beside means one square up, down, left or right, within the same area.
A corner touches two adjacent area boundaries. Doors do not merge areas.
Alone means no other person in the area. With means in the same area; alone with means exactly two people.
Outer border means the first or last row or column of the whole grid.
In front of a door/window means either of its two joined squares.

public.title: A Will Read at Midnight

public.goal: Place everyone, then name the person who was alone with Vincent Vane.
rules: One person per row and column, including the victim.
Crossed squares are blocked. All other squares may be occupied, including furniture without a cross.
Beside means one square up, down, left or right, within the same area.
A corner touches two adjacent area boundaries. Doors do not merge areas.
Alone means no other person in the area. With means in the same area; alone with means exactly two people.
Outer border means the first or last row or column of the whole grid.
In front of a door/window means either of its two joined squares.
Offsets compare only the named coordinate. Area numbers start at 1; zero people is an even count.
Terrain is the ground layer, separate from named props that may share its label.
The murderer was alone with the victim: exactly two people in that area.

Ada Ashworth was the only person in their area. Ada Ashworth was beside an oak table.
Someone else in Vincent Vane's area was beside a wingback chair. Vincent Vane was not in a corner of their area.
Someone else in Dorian Dale's area was beside a wingback chair. Dorian Dale was not beside a marble bust.
Felix Fairweather's row was 1 row below Dorian Dale's row. Felix Fairweather was not in a corner of their area.

Vincent Vane was in the Dining Room or the Library.

public.title: Dust on the Keys
public.blurb: The clocks were wound, the silver polished, and by morning the house had a new heir.
public.goal: Place everyone, then name the person who was alone with Vera Vane.
rules: One person per row and column, including the victim.
Crossed squares are blocked. All other squares may be occupied, including furniture without a cross.
Beside means one square up, down, left or right, within the same area.
A corner touches two adjacent area boundaries. Doors do not merge areas.
Alone means no other person in the area. With means in the same area; alone with means exactly two people.
Outer border means the first or last row or column of the whole grid.
In front of a door/window means either of its two joined squares.
Offsets compare only the named coordinate. Area numbers start at 1; zero people is an even count.
Terrain is the ground layer, separate from named props that may share its label.
The murderer was alone with the victim: exactly two people in that area.

Basil Blackwood was in the same area as Ada Ashworth. Basil Blackwood was in a corner of their area.
Cleo Carrow was the only person beside a wingback chair. Cleo Carrow was not in a corner of their area.
Someone else in Dorian Dale's area was beside a wine cask.
Felix Fairweather was the only person beside a writing desk.
Vera Vane was not in a corner of their area.
Greta Gale was alone with Dorian Dale — only those two were in that area.
Nobody was in the Library.

public.goal: Place everyone, then name the person who was alone with Violet Vane.
rules: One person per row and column, including the victim.
Crossed squares are blocked. All other squares may be occupied, including furniture without a cross.
Beside means one square up, down, left or right, within the same area.
A corner touches two adjacent area boundaries. Doors do not merge areas.
Alone means no other person in the area. With means in the same area; alone with means exactly two people.
Outer border means the first or last row or column of the whole grid.
In front of a door/window means either of its two joined squares.
Offsets compare only the named coordinate. Area numbers start at 1; zero people is an even count.
Terrain is the ground layer, separate from named props that may share its label.
The murderer was alone with the victim: exactly two people in that area.

clues.text: Greta Gale was in the Great Hall or the Carriage Hall or the Egyptian Wing.
Ada Ashworth was in the Carriage Hall.
Cleo Carrow was alone with Felix Fairweather — only those two were in that area. Someone else in Cleo Carrow's area was beside a shipping crate.
Dorian Dale was north-west of Basil Blackwood.
Esme Elwood was alone with Dorian Dale — only those two were in that area. Esme Elwood was the only person on a gilded throne.
Felix Fairweather was on an antique carriage.
Basil Blackwood was not beside a meteorite. Basil Blackwood was in the Music Room.

public.title: Curtain Call for a Corpse
public.blurb: Everyone in the company knows their lines. Somebody also knew their cue.
public.goal: Place everyone, then name the person who was alone with Vera Vane.
rules: One person per row and column, including the victim.
Crossed squares are blocked. All other squares may be occupied, including furniture without a cross.
Beside means one square up, down, left or right, within the same area.
A corner touches two adjacent area boundaries. Doors do not merge areas.
Alone means no other person in the area. With means in the same area; alone with means exactly two people.
Outer border means the first or last row or column of the whole grid.
In front of a door/window means either of its two joined squares.
Offsets compare only the named coordinate. Area numbers start at 1; zero people is an even count.
Terrain is the ground layer, separate from named props that may share its label.
The murderer was alone with the victim: exactly two people in that area.

clues.text: Dorian Dale was the only person beside a plaster bust.
Ada Ashworth was alone with Dorian Dale — only those two were in that area.
Cleo Carrow was the only person on a pumpkin coach. Cleo Carrow was north-east of Ada Ashworth.
Cleo Carrow was in the same area as Esme Elwood.
Basil Blackwood was not beside a director's chair.

public.title: A Tragedy in Three Acts
public.blurb: Everyone in the company knows their lines. Somebody also knew their cue.
public.goal: Place everyone, then name the person who was alone with Vaughn Vane.
rules: One person per row and column, including the victim.
Crossed squares are blocked. All other squares may be occupied, including furniture without a cross.
Beside means one square up, down, left or right, within the same area.
A corner touches two adjacent area boundaries. Doors do not merge areas.
Alone means no other person in the area. With means in the same area; alone with means exactly two people.
Outer border means the first or last row or column of the whole grid.
In front of a door/window means either of its two joined squares.
Offsets compare only the named coordinate. Area numbers start at 1; zero people is an even count.
Terrain is the ground layer, separate from named props that may share its label.
The murderer was alone with the victim: exactly two people in that area.

Ada Ashworth was beside a plaster bust.
Felix Fairweather was not in a corner of their area. Felix Fairweather was in the Rehearsal Room or the Stage.

rules: One person per row and column, including the victim.
Crossed squares are blocked. All other squares may be occupied, including furniture without a cross.
Beside means one square up, down, left or right, within the same area.
A corner touches two adjacent area boundaries. Doors do not merge areas.
Alone means no other person in the area. With means in the same area; alone with means exactly two people.
Outer border means the first or last row or column of the whole grid.
In front of a door/window means either of its two joined squares.
Offsets compare only the named coordinate. Area numbers start at 1; zero people is an even count.
Terrain is the ground layer, separate from named props that may share its label.
The murderer was alone with the victim: exactly two people in that area.

rules: One person per row and column, including the victim.
Crossed squares are blocked. All other squares may be occupied, including furniture without a cross.
Beside means one square up, down, left or right, within the same area.
A corner touches two adjacent area boundaries. Doors do not merge areas.
Alone means no other person in the area. With means in the same area; alone with means exactly two people.
Outer border means the first or last row or column of the whole grid.
In front of a door/window means either of its two joined squares.
Offsets compare only the named coordinate. Area numbers start at 1; zero people is an even count.
Terrain is the ground layer, separate from named props that may share its label.
The murderer was alone with the victim: exactly two people in that area.
